title: Apply to work with us
description: About ten minutes. A real person reads every answer and we will tell you honestly whether we are the right studio. Answer the track-specific questions that apply to you and skip the rest.

questions.label: Which of these describes you best?
questions.description: Same studio, different starting point. Pick the one that is closest; you can tell us more below.

options.label: Creator: I have an audience and want to build a business under it
Founder: I have a business and want to build an audience for it
Both: I am doing each side already

questions.label: Link to your main channel, website or company page
questions.description: The one place we should look first.

questions.label: Where will your engagement be billed?
questions.description: Clients outside Pakistan are billed in USD; clients in Pakistan are billed in PKR.

questions.label: What are you building, and what is in the way?
questions.description: A following that does not pay yet, or a business nobody has heard of: tell us which, in a few honest sentences.

questions.label: Average monthly revenue over the last six months
questions.description: Your channel's or your company's, in the currency you chose above (USD or PKR). Enter 0 if you are pre-revenue.

questions.description: Pick up to three. One system built properly beats six built badly.

questions.label: What number would tell you this worked?
questions.description: We agree one number before we start: revenue per follower, conversion rate, deal size, cost of winning a customer. Give us yours, with a rough target and timeframe.

How many hours a week can you, or the person we will work with, give to this?
questions.description: Shoots, approvals, calls and decisions. We build the system so it does not need you every day, but it does need you.
